card.title: VP, Manufacturing and Supply Chain
card.description:
In this role you will lead GMP Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing Science and Technology (MS&T). It ensures reliable clinical and commercial supply through scalable manufacturing, resilient supply chains, and science-based process optimization. The VP sits on the Technical Operations leadership team. The VP partners with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Facilities, Engineering, Finance, Research, and external partners.

This is an on-site role in Torrey Pines, CA that requires flexibility and availability for weekend and holiday work as needed. Relocation is not available.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Strategy and Organization**: Set manufacturing strategy, build and scale the organization, and plan capacity and workforce.
* **Compliance and Quality:** Ensure cGMP and regulatory compliance and keep the site inspection-ready with Quality.
* **Process and Technology:** Drive process performance, technology transfer, MS&T lifecycle activities, and automation, digitalization, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
* **Supply chain and Partners:** Oversee supply planning, sourcing, and Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP). Manage CDMOs and critical suppliers.
* **Regulatory and Facilities:** Support regulatory filings (INDs and BLAs) and partner on facility expansion and qualification.
* **Finance and Reporting:** Manage budgets and capital plans, set KPIs, and report risks and recommendations to executives and the Board.
* **Culture and Representation:** Foster a culture of safety, compliance, and continuous improvement, and represent the company in external forums.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* + A bachelor's degree in engineering or life sciences is required. An advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is preferred.
* At least 15 years in biopharma or cell and gene therapy manufacturing, including 8 or more years in senior leadership.

***Required:***

* GMP manufacturing leadership
* Process development and scale-up
* MS&T and technology transfer
* Supply chain and CDMO management
* Regulatory inspection experience with the FDA, EMA, and others
* Leading large teams and delivering on budget and schedule

***Preferred:***

* Experience with automation, MES, and digital manufacturing. Prior autologous cell therapy manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS:**

* Executive and People leadership
* Enterprise Judgement and Risk Management
* Financial Acumen
* Executive Communication.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

General office, manufacturing, laboratory, and cleanroom environment. This position requires occasional presence in GMP manufacturing areas and interaction with production operations. The employee may be exposed to standard laboratory materials and manufacturing equipment. Domestic and international travel may be required. Some Cleanroom access is required

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

These work environment characteristics are representative of the environment the job holder will encounter. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable people with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

**EEO and Employment Eligibility:**

Aspen Neuroscience is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and job applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Aspen is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have valid work authorization that does not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

**Total Rewards and Culture:**

Aspen Neuroscience, Inc., located in scenic Torrey Pines, is noted for its collaborative and learning focused culture where each person is valued for contributing their strengths and energy to building a world-class line of products for patients in need. The company offers a competitive total compensation package, time-off in addition to Company observed holidays, Medical/Dental insurance benefits, onsite gym, and other wellness perks.

The anticipated salary range for candidates who will work in San Diego is $308,700-$377,300 annually. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and length of experience within the industry, education, etc. Aspen Neuroscience is multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states.

Description: 

We’re seeking a Plant Manager - Asphalt who’s ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America.

 

**Job Title:** Plant Manager - Asphalt **| Req ID:** 18651 | **HR Contact:** Fredric Victor THOMPSON| **Location:** Stoughton MA

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

 

The Plant Manager is accountable for the leadership, development & management of all functions of the HMA manufacturing business at this location. The Plant Manager will ensure lean staffing and oversee safe production to enable plant productivity and maintenance in an efficient manner, while producing quality products for customers. The primary focus will be on safety, compliance and optimum manufacturingmaximizing productivity at the lowest cost of production. Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and supervising the activities of one or more asphalt plants. The Plant Manager communicates goals to department employees and ensures that goals are achieved. Maximizes employee participation to achieve the desired team approach. Develops departmental personnel to enhance skills, improve responsiveness and promote business growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Coordinate the execution of general plant operations activities. Coordinate field management activities.
* Help coordinate activities such as transportation and receiving of product at the plant.
* Ensure that we produce quality products that meet or exceed customer expectations
* Inspect product quality ensuring all criteria meets plan. Recommend measures to improve production methods and equipment performance.
* Provides timely and accurate tickets for customers. Runs loader or dozer at bins and stock pile, and performs plant maintenance and housekeeping.
* Monitor, recommend, implements repairs and routine maintenance of equipment, buildings and grounds.
* Investigates abnormal operating events or equipment failures to determine cause; makes adjustments,repairs, and/or modifications as needed.
* Directly supervises 2 – 8 employees in the HMA division . Coach, train, mentor employees on the safe and efficient method of operating plant equipment. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees, planning, assigning and directing work rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
* Supports and assists personnel in achieving timely and
 
 efficient production schedules. Records employees’ time in online timekeeping system.
* Communicates and promotes safety, compliance and environmental requirements in alignment with company standards within production area. Monitors work performed and addresses situations that do not conform to standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
 
**Education:** Bachelor's degree or 6 years of equivalent experience
 
**Required Work Experience:** Minimum of six years of production-related work experience. Related supervisory or group leader experience preferred.
 
**Required Technical Skills:** Basic computer skills with ability to enter information in SAP and time recording software and working with Microsoft Office applications

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved. Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. Subject to applicable law, employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.
 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary
* Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program
* Dress for your day

We're seeking builders, creative thinkers and innovators. Come put your expertise to work while developing the knowledge and skills to drive your career forward. The **Senior Manager Production** position manages the day-to-day operations of all shifts of a large facility with multiple Value Streams within the Integrated Drivetrain Energy Solutions (IDES) division. Additionally, the role will lead 1-2 managers focused on the Modern Manufacturing and Lean Capability's within the Assembly & Test Operations of Building KK and H.

* Managing staffing, development, and performance management programs for operations staff; managing, motivating, and developing management team.

card.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite.  Job Description 
 
  
 Gilead Sciences is seeking an experienced validation leader to head the Manufacturing Validation function at the Foster City site. This role will establish and lead an integrated, risk-based validation program for the facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and computerized systems supporting a new state-of-the-art biologics facility. In partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Automation, IT, and project teams, this leader will define the validation framework, build the capabilities required for execution, and ensure the new facility is compliant and inspection-ready from startup through routine operations. The successful candidate will also lead and integrate the existing validation team supporting the site’s small-molecule clinical manufacturing pilot plants and warehouse. 
   
 Required Skills: 
 Demonstrated leadership of validation for the startup and licensure of a new biotech or biologics manufacturing facility. 
 Significant experience designing and implementing risk-based, lifecycle validation approaches in a GMP-regulated environment. 
 Deep technical knowledge of facility, utility and equipment qualification and computer system validation, including applicable regulatory expectations and industry standards. 
 Proven ability to build validation organizations and governance, establish clear accountabilities, and lead employees, contractors, and partner functions through complex startup programs. 
 Strong cross-functional influence, decision-making, and communication skills, with an unwavering commitment to quality, data integrity, cGMP compliance, and patient safety. 
 
 Job Responsibilities: 

 Establish the site validation strategy 
Develop and implement an integrated, risk-based validation strategy, governance, acceptance criteria, and oversight model for facilities, utilities, process equipment, automation platforms, and GMP computer systems supporting the new Foster City biologics facility. 
 Lead validation through facility startup 
Provide site validation leadership and oversight from design and construction through commissioning, qualification, process readiness, and transition to routine GMP operations in alignment with the overall project schedule. 
 Implement risk-based validation 
Apply science- and risk-based principles to focus testing and documentation on critical aspects, leverage supplier and commissioning evidence where appropriate, and maintain clear traceability to patient, product, and data-integrity risks. 
 Build a high performing validation department
Provide leadership guidance and coaching for existing and new validation department employees, forecast and manage workload, and support employee career growth. 
 Build governance and execution capability 
Establish standards, procedures, templates, metrics, and decision forums; define roles across internal teams, engineering partners, vendors, and contractors; and develop a high-performing validation organization sized for each phase of the program. 
 Drive inspection readiness and sustainable operations 
Partner with Quality and system owners to ensure the new biologics facility and existing small molecule facilities are inspection-ready, including validation ownership, periodic review, change control, requalification, maintenance of the validated state, and continual improvement. 
  
 Qualifications: 

 Requires a Masters degree with 8+ years of relevant professional experience, or BS with 10+ years of relevant professional experience – a degree in a relevant scientific or business discipline is strongly preferred. 
 Hands-on experience implementing risk-based validation in a biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 
 Excellent organizational and communication (both written and verbal) skills. 
 Demonstrated experience leading and engaging a team of technical experts. 
 
 The ideal candidate would also have:
 Significant experience with facility, equipment and utility qualification for startup of a manufacturing facility. 
 Significant experience with computerized system validation in a biopharmaceutical environment. 
 Strategic thinking and ability to influence and constructively challenge the status quo.

 As part of Gilead's Enterprise Data and ERP strategy, we are seeking a Senior Manager, SAP Manufacturing and Planning to serve as the Product Owner for enterprise-wide manufacturing execution, production planning, and shop floor digitization capabilities across our pharmaceutical and biologics manufacturing network.  
 
This leader will define and execute the enterprise roadmap for S/4HANA Production Planning (PP), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)/Digital Manufacturing, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and segmentation capabilities, while enabling GxP-compliant manufacturing transformation across Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Kite organizations. 

 This position will report to the Associate Director, IT ERP PDM. This is an onsite role based on Foster City, CA or Raleigh, NC. We do offer a hybrid environment with three days in office and two days work from home. 

  
 Key Responsibilities 

 Manufacturing Strategy & Business Partnership 
 Develop and articulate a comprehensive SAP Manufacturing solution roadmap that aligns with the company's long-term business objectives within the Life Sciences sector. 
 Architect scalable and flexible SAP solutions that can adapt to evolving business requirements and regulatory landscapes. 
 Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain leaders to define enterprise production priorities. 
 Establish standards, operating procedures, and best practices for production planning and shop floor execution. 
 Evaluate and recommend emerging SAP technologies and best practices to enhance system performance and efficiency 
 Drive manufacturing data quality, GxP compliance, standardization, and business value realization. 
 Produce detailed architectural blueprints, including data flow diagrams, system interface specifications, and configuration documentation. 
 Manufacturing & Platform Ownership 
 Own the strategy, governance, architecture, and continuous improvement of S/4HANA PP, MES/Digital Manufacturing, and MRP platforms across multiple sites. 
 Govern enterprise SAP manufacturing domains, including Production Orders, Routings, BOMs, Work Centers, Batch Management, and Shop Floor Integration.  
 Define enterprise standards for production planning, execution, and manufacturing data quality within a validated (GxP) environment.  
 Lead integration strategy connecting third-party MES platforms — including Werum PAS-X — with S/4HANA PP, MRP, and (where relevant) IBP/Kinaxis for seamless demand-supply and shop floor alignment. 
 Delivery Leadership & Operational Excellence 
 Lead delivery of enterprise manufacturing initiatives including MES rollouts, PAS-X integrations and upgrades, PP/MRP optimization, and Digital Manufacturing transformation programs. 
 Lead cross-functional teams including Manufacturing SMEs, Architects, Analysts, AMS partners, and System Integrators. 
 Establish KPIs for production performance, planning accuracy, system adoption, GxP compliance, and operational excellence. 
 Drive platform stability, validation lifecycle adherence (CSV/CSA), and continuous improvement across manufacturing sites. 
 Leadership 
 Build enterprise manufacturing systems capabilities and digital maturity. 
 Lead manufacturing systems councils and governance forums. 
 Influence senior leaders on manufacturing technology strategy, investments, and operating model decisions. 
 Foster a culture of operational excellence, quality ownership, and accountability on the shop floor. 
  
 Basic Qualifications:  
 Bachelor's Degree and Eight Years’ Experience OR 
 Masters' Degree and Six Years’ Experience

 Key Skills & Experience 
 12+ years of SAP Production Planning, Manufacturing Execution Systems, and manufacturing/supply chain technology experience. 
 Deep expertise in S/4HANA PP, MRP, and MES/Digital Manufacturing platforms, with hands-on integration experience across third-party MES systems such as Werum PAS-X, SAP DMC, or similar.  
 Working knowledge of SAP IBP / Kinaxis and its integration with production planning and MRP.  
 Experience defining and enabling SAP segmentation capabilities across planning and manufacturing processes, including segmentation strategy, master data design, inventory and batch segmentation, and integration with S/4HANA PP/MRP, SAP IBP/Kinaxis, MES/Digital Manufacturing, and shop floor execution processes. 
 Strong understanding of GxP methodologies, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), and regulated pharmaceutical/biologics manufacturing environments.  
 Experience leading enterprise-wide manufacturing digitization and transformation programs.  
 Strong understanding of cross-functional manufacturing, quality, and supply chain process dependencies.  
 Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and product ownership experience.

Bay Area: $169,320.00 - $219,120.00.

 Job Description: 
 The Company 
 
 We build the machines that power industry. We are Hitachi Global Air Power, a leading global industrial compressed air manufacturer driving the innovations that keep the world moving.
 
 From our headquarters in Michigan City, Indiana, our compressed air solutions power manufacturing operations all around the globe; from food and beverage to life-saving pharmaceuticals and cutting-edge semiconductor chips. Our portable compressors provide the air power to build roads and bridges, lay pipelines and aid in oil and gas mining and production.
 
 We are a team of innovators, engineers, and quality experts with a shared vision to create the next generation of efficient, environment-forward compressed air solutions that meet the demands of today, while boldly contributing to a sustainable, circular economy. With more than 58 years of legacy and trusted performance through our brands - Hitachi, Sullair, and Champion (Australia), we are proud of our reputation for reliability, durability, and performance and groundbreaking engineering.
 
 Join us in building a future where your work has an impact. At Hitachi Global Air Power, you’ll be part of a global network that’s shaping the future of industrial power.
 
 Summary of the position: 
 
 Reporting to the HGAP Vice President of Operations, the successful candidate collaborates with the VP and the executive leadership team to execute manufacturing plans that drive corporate strategy and profitability.
 
 This role requires a visionary leader who can align manufacturing strategies with business objectives, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure the highest levels of safety, cost, quality, efficiency, utilization and on-time finish.
 
 The incumbent maintains full ownership of all fabrication, machining, and assembly operations. This mandate includes directing facility management, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement initiatives.
 
 This role directly impacts revenue growth by optimizing production costs and improving efficiency, productivity, and employee engagement. The leader secures commercial success by consistently meeting or exceeding production schedules on time, under budget with premium quality standards and HGAP safety guidelines.
 
 This position is located on-site in Michigan City, Indiana. 
 
 
 Duties and responsibilities: 
 Key Accountabilities: 
 •            Manufacturing Performance Metrics (Safety, Cost, Quality, Productivity, Efficiency, Plant Utilization, Overtime Reduction, Production Finishes to Schedule and Preventative maintenance)
 •            Ensuring a culture of Safety, Employee engagement and Continuous improvement in manufacturing.
 •            Optimize cost of production and manufacturing footprint requirements.
   
 
 KEY REQUIREMENTS:   
 Collaborate with the cross functional teams within HGAP to maximize business
 growth opportunities. 
 Manages the overall manufacturing operations of the plants; ensures goals are met for Safety, Cost, Quality and On-time finish while concurrently ensuring company profit margin and cost of production meet the targets.
 Leads active efforts that enable standardization (when feasible), cost and manufacturing waste reduction and 6S.
 Responsible for the manufacture and on-time finishes of products
 Implements changes to production methods or materials flow that align with efforts to optimize productivity, achieve cost savings and enable product production goals.
 Leads product lead-time objectives established by the VP of Operations
 Partners with Engineering to support the manufacture and on-time product launch of New products at the target product cost.
 Oversees the workflow that satisfies production requirements in a cost efficient manner.
 Manages maintenance of plant and production areas, including preventative maintenance programs and initiatives.
 Prepares manufacturing reports including analysis and quantitative explanation of issues, performance, and improvements.
 Drives operation cost reduction initiatives (direct & indirect).  Measures results and report out progress.
 Champion of lean manufacturing and Continuous improvements.  Provide monthly measurable results from such initiatives.
 Optimize cost of production provides monthly updates and reporting regarding process improvements impacts on company cash flow.
 Collaborate with cross functional teams and provides actionable information to improve product Safety, Cost, Quality and plants throughput
 Works with various operation departments and cross functional teams to meet and exceed manufacturing KPI’s standards.
 Works with executive staff to ensure company strategic initiatives are instituted and ensure tangible benefits are achieved through monthly measuring
 Establishes and maintains annual manufacturing operating plans, budgets, capital appropriation, and manpower to assure the most productive utilization of human, financial and capital resources.
 Ensures HGAP plants meet and/or exceed local, state, federal
           and international plant safety standards.
 Ensures personnel and equipment training standards are met and develops      
     relevant tactical and strategic training plans (with human resources) for
     applicable personnel. Champion of lessons learned.
 Drives continuous improvement and quantitative decision-making methods
 throughout the manufacturing teams.
 Oversees efforts to maximize production line efficiencies and effective employee utilization within the plants.
 Champion of safe work practices that ensure workers’ health and safety.
 Participate in sales and operations discussions/status meetings with key customer accounts and distributors, as warranted.
 Establishes and optimizes an organizational structure that maximizes the manufacturing team’s effectiveness.
 Leads and sets the pace for talent selection, onboarding, performance management, development and engagement to propel HGAP talent experience; plays an active role in developing future leaders for HGAP.
 
 Qualifications: 
 
 Education : 
 Degree: Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management, or Business Administration.
 Certifications: Highly desirable credentials include Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP), or Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM)
 
 QUALIFICATIONS: 
 Minimum of 5 to 8 years of senior level manufacturing and/or operations leadership role (e.g., Plant Manager or Operations Director).
 Minimum of 15 years industry experience (heavy equipment, machinery, durable goods).
 Proven track record of managing large budgets, scaling production output, and leading major process or continuous improvement initiatives, profitably growing and transforming a business.
 Strong experience in establishing and improving manufacturing disciplines and overall operational efficiencies in an industrial environment.
 Exceptional interpersonal and cross-functional communication skills to coordinate between the factory floor and executive stakeholders
 Must have demonstrated effective influence with key leaders within a matrixed organization.
 Ability to manage resources, prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects.
 Strong ability to mentor leadership teams, manage organizational change, and drive succession planning.
 Ability to analyze situations in a structured and logical manner and take calculated approaches to managing risk.
 Strategic Thinking: Capacity to align plant operations with overarching corporate goals and financial targets and attention to detail.
 Strong evaluation and analytical capabilities required. Data driven.
 Excellent business acumen.
 Strong work ethic and integrity; high energy and interpersonal skills.
 Collaborative, accomplished team member.
 Operate with sense of urgency, responsibility, ownership and accountability  
 Computer literate. Deep familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle)
 Strong understanding of regulatory standards and quality management systems (such as ISO, OSHA, and IATF)
 Strong project management skills, PMP certification is a plus.
 Six Sigma Black/Green Belt certification a plus
 Precision machining or automotive industry experience is a plus
 
 
 Direct reports: 
 Facility and maintenance Senior manager
 Value stream managers of Fabrication, AirEnd and F/G assembly
 
 The successful candidate is responsible for complying with Hitachi Global Air Power Code of Ethics and related policies. In performing the job, the incumbent shall take all steps necessary to comply with our safety policies and requirements and must actively support the organization's efforts to meet and exceed its goals of creating and maintaining a safe workplace.
 
 This job description is to serve as a guide. It is intended to be flexible and will continue to evolve over time with business needs and demands and may be updated periodically and at the Company's discretion.
 
 Hitachi Global Air Power is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate based on race, religion, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, physical or mental disability, or other protected categories under applicable law, whether in recruitment, employment, promotion, transfer, compensation, or other conditions of employment.

**Your experience matters**

UW Health Rehabilitation Hospital - Fitchburg is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. By joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve. Come join us on our journey of opening a brand-new hospital!

**More about our team**

UW Health Rehabilitation Hospital - Fitchburg is a brand-new 40 bed inpatient rehabilitation facility opening in 2027. We offer high-quality, compassionate care for a wide variety of patients in need. We strive to maximize the health, function, and quality of life of those we serve through comprehensive physical medicine and rehabilitation programs.

**How you'll contribute**

A Director of Plant Operations who excels in this role:

* Develops and recommends departmental policies and procedures.
* Develops programs to ensure departmental effectiveness.
* Monitors existing policies, procedures and programs for effectiveness.
* Develops, implements, administers and modifies programs to maintain the physical plant, grounds, and equipment of the hospital through effective utilization of personnel and materials.
* Maintains required documentation for state, federal and other regulatory agencies.
* Develops and determines priorities and monitors status of special projects on an ongoing basis.
* Assures complete and proper logging of files and records and required cost computation of time spent, materials and supplies used for each completed requisition or work order.
* Inspects building and grounds to ensure conformance with established standards and regulations.
* Establishes preventive maintenance schedules and prioritizes repair and maintenance work to minimize disruption of hospital operations.

**Why join us**

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

* **Comprehensive Benefits**: Multiple levels of medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time employees.
* **Financial Protection & PTO**: Life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid family leave and paid time off.
* **Financial & Career Growth**: Higher education and certification tuition assistance, loan assistance and 401(k) retirement package and company match.
* **Employee Well-being**: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs).
* **Professional Development**: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.
* **Brand new facility:** Brand new hospital, built from the ground up, with cutting-edge equipment and technology!

**What we're looking for**

Applicants should possess the following qualifications and skills:

* Education: One (1) year certificate from college or technical school; or 3 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience: Experience in hospital operations and survey preparedness highly preferred
* Additional requirements: Knowledge of utility systems management. Basic computer knowledge.

**About Us** 
UW Health Rehabilitation Hospital - Fitchburg is a brand-new 40 bed inpatient rehabilitation facility committed to offering exceptional care to the Fitchburg community. We are part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to *making communities healthier*® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast.

**EEOC Statement**

UW Health Rehabilitation Hospital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. UW Health Rehabilitation Hospital is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment in employment.

card.title: Plant Director
card.description:
About SunOpta
 
SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions and innovation for top brands, retailers, and foodservice providers across a broad portfolio of beverages, broths, and better-for-you snacks. With over 50 years of expertise, SunOpta fuels customers’ growth with high-quality, sustainability-forward solutions distributed through retail, club, foodservice, and e-commerce channels across North America.
 
 
**Job Summary:** 
The Plant Director leads all aspects of plant operations, ensuring the delivery of the highest-quality products at the lowest sustainable cost while maintaining the safest, most environmentally responsible operating environment. Sets the strategic direction for manufacturing, drives operational excellence, and fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all plant functions. Champions talent development and organizational effectiveness by building a strong leadership pipeline, attracting, developing, and retaining top talent, and empowering employees at all levels to reach their full potential. Cultivates an inclusive, high-performance culture that values engagement, teamwork, ownership, and shared success. Provides leadership and guidance to ensure alignment with company goals, long-term growth objectives, and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**Essential Functions of the Job:** 

* Develops and executes the plant’s strategic and operational plans to achieve production, cost, quality, safety, and environmental targets, influencing both direct reports and dotted-line stakeholders to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and long-term growth.
* Oversees multi-line, 24/7 manufacturing operations, ensuring optimal production scheduling, resource allocation, and workforce management while balancing short-term needs with long-term operational priorities.
* Leads capital planning and plant improvement initiatives, engaging both direct teams and matrixed partners to implement equipment upgrades, process optimizations, and technology projects that maximize efficiency and ROI.
* Establishes and monitors key performance metrics, including OEE, throughput, waste reduction, and labor efficiency, leveraging operational data to drive continuous improvement and cost containment across the plant.
* Provides oversight and influence across Maintenance, Production, Quality, Engineering, EHS, and Supply Chain functions in a matrixed organization, leveraging both direct and dotted-line relationships to ensure alignment, coordinated planning, preventive programs, and successful cross-functional initiatives.
* Influences and partners with cross-functional leaders to ensure robust food safety programs, adherence to GMPs, and compliance with all regulatory and customer standards.
* Oversees all plant financial responsibilities, including budgets, capital expenditures, cost control, staffing, and productivity reporting. Provides strategic insight to Finance and executive leadership to support operational and investment decisions.
* Drives employee engagement and organizational development by partnering with HR and plant leadership to attract, develop, and retain top talent; build leadership capabilities and succession strength; establish clear performance expectations and accountability; and foster a high-performing culture rooted in collaboration, continuous learning, and shared ownership of results.
* Acts as the primary liaison between plant operations and corporate leadership, providing operational updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations for continuous growth and efficiency improvement.
* Serves as the key decision-maker in operational issues, including crisis management, production disruptions, and long-term operational planning.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** 

* Direct Reports: Responsible for directly managing various functions including Operations/Production Manager(s), Maintenance, EHS, etc.)

**Minimum Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Food Science, related field; or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of leadership experience in Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated manufacturing environment
* Proven experience leading multi-shift, multi-line operations with P&L responsibility

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Master’s Degree
* Bilingual in Spanish

**Knowledge and Skills:** 

* Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of delivering operational excellence in complex manufacturing environments
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, or other continuous improvement methodologies with demonstrated results in efficiency, waste reduction, and cost management
* Strong financial acumen, including budget management, cost forecasting, and productivity analytics
* In-depth knowledge of regulatory compliance, food safety, environmental standards, and employee safety programs
* Polished leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire cross-functional teams and senior executives

**Additional Considerations:** 

* Travel Expectation: Some travel required.
* Location: This role will be located at our plant in Omak, WA.
* Work Environment: This work will be split between a manufacturing environment and office environment.

Featured Benefits
 

* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Paid Family leave
* Paid maternity leave
* 401(k) with Match
* Voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness and Hospital indemnity
* Paid Holidays
* Tuition assistance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability insurance

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.
 
 
AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

card.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

What you'll do:
Lead manufacturing engineering efforts for electromechanical subsystems and assemblies
Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for:
Actuators
Motors and drives
Hydraulic systems
Pneumatic systems
Pumps and fluid systems
Powertrain components
Motion-control assemblies
Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility
Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for electromechanical manufacturing issues
Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods
Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews
Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing
Support system integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities
Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria
Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives
Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams
Mentor junior manufacturing engineers

MES & QMS systems, 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems, supplier manufacturing processes, 5S/visual management, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in experience in electromechanical systems
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field
Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment.
Experience with:
Actuators and motion systems
Hydraulics and pneumatics
Mechanical/electrical integration
Precision mechanical assemblies
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities.
Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling
Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles
Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies
Preferred qualifications:
Aerospace, defense, robotics, or automotive industry experience
Experience with servo systems and motor control assemblies
Knowledge of GD&T and mechanical inspection methods
Familiarity with lean manufacturing and production optimization
Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis
Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines
Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001
Proficiency in CAD software

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc.

**Plant Manager**

Ellisville, MS, United States | req34514

**What you will enjoy doing\***

**What you will enjoy doing**

* Drive the PGT Lean Operating System through daily management, leader standard work, visual management, structured problem solving, standard work, and continuous improvement

* Own the financial performance of the facility, including budgets, labor efficiency, overtime, productivity, cost improvement, operational spending, and capital priorities
* Lead cross-functionally and create a strong site culture, partnering with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS, Human Resources, and Finance while fostering respect, transparency, employee engagement, urgency, and continuous improvement

**What makes you great**

* You have a Bachelor’s degree with ten (10) or more years of related manufacturing experience, a Master’s degree with eight (8) or more years, a PhD with five (5) or more years, or sixteen (16) or more years of directly related manufacturing experience

* You have demonstrated experience applying Lean principles, daily management, standard work, and structured problem solving to deliver measurable operational improvement

Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.

At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless. 
 
Linde offers competitive compensation and an outstanding benefits package. Enjoy access to health, dental, disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and vacation, 401(k) matching, pension benefits, an employee discount program, and opportunities for educational and professional growth. Additional compensation may vary depending on the position and organizational level. Build your future with us while making an impact every day!

We are looking forward to receiving your complete application.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.

Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

card.title: Director, Enterprise Business Transformation & Operational Excellence
card.description:
**Job Title:** Director, Enterprise Business Transformation & Operational Excellence

**Location:** Westfield, IN

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

 
 

We are seeking a hands-on transformation leader to drive enterprise-wide strategy, operating-model improvements, and value creation across a complex, multi-site industrial business. This role is a core member of the organizational leadership team, with a mandate to personally lead, structure, analyze, and execute transformation initiatives—working directly with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to turn strategy into measurable results.

 
 

This person will operate as a strategic problem solver and execution partner, identifying opportunities, building business cases, redesigning processes, and driving initiatives through implementation and value realization. For the right candidate, this role offers a clear path to building and leading a dedicated transformation team as the capability matures within the organization.

 
 

**OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Personally lead enterprise transformation and operating-model improvement initiatives from problem definition and strategy through execution and measurable value realization.
* Analyze business performance, identify operational and financial improvement opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Drive operational excellence initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous-improvement methodologies to improve cost, quality, safety, delivery, and profitability.
* Lead and support M&A activities, including due diligence, post-merger integration, carve-outs, and synergy/value-capture initiatives.
* Build and maintain transformation roadmaps, business cases, financial models, project plans, KPIs, and governance mechanisms.
* Work directly with commercial, finance, and operations leaders to improve P&L performance, profitable growth, and value creation.
* Identify opportunities to modernize core systems and processes, including ERP/SAP, and evaluate AI-enabled and digital solutions based on measurable business impact.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, resolve complex business problems, and personally drive critical initiatives to completion.
* Collaborate with colleagues in our Strategy and Transformation office in Europe, contributing to globally coordinated initiatives and sharing best practices across geographies.
* Present findings, recommendations, progress, and results to executive leadership and other key stakeholders
 

 

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* 10+ years of experience in transformation, strategy, operations, management consulting, or operational excellence, ideally within industrial, manufacturing, automation, or supply-chain environments.
* Demonstrated experience personally driving complex transformation initiatives from analysis through implementation, rather than primarily overseeing teams or programs.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable results, including revenue growth, margin expansion, cost reduction, productivity improvements, and other value-creation initiatives.
* Deep expertise in operational excellence, Lean / Six Sigma, and structured problem solving; Black Belt preferred.
* Experience with M&A integration, operating-model design, process optimization, and value-capture initiatives.
* Strong financial acumen, including P&L, EBIT, business cases, ROI, planning, and financial modeling.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and execution skills with the ability to move from high-level strategy into detailed implementation.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* MBA from a leading program and/or an engineering background strongly preferred.
* Experience with AI-enabled / digital transformation and agentic GTM.
* Warehouse/manufacturing automation domain knowledge, including WES/MES, aftermarket service, or commercial project controlling.
* ERP/SAP implementation or optimization experience.
* Global / multi-continent experience, particularly US and APAC.
* Experience working in a PE-backed or highly performance-driven industrial environment.

**PROFESSIONAL QUALITIES**

* Hands-on and action-oriented, with a willingness to personally dive into analysis, problem-solving, and execution.
* Highly analytical and intellectually curious, with the ability to simplify complex business challenges and identify practical solutions.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build credibility across all levels of the organization.
* Results-driven and accountable, with a strong focus on measurable business impact and value creation.
* Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and lead change without relying on direct authority.
 

 

**WORK CONDITIONS**

* Regular in-office collaboration with executive and cross-functional teams.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support business initiatives, operating locations, and global collaboration.
* Fast-paced, highly visible role requiring the ability to manage multiple strategic priorities and adapt as business needs evolve.
* Regular interaction with senior leadership and teams across functions, business units, and geographies.
 

 

**Why work for Storage Solutions – A Jungheinrich Company?**

At Storage Solutions, our greatest asset is our people. We have built a team of passionate intralogistics experts who collaborate and partner with distribution and fulfillment operations across North America and worldwide. We believe in providing tailored solutions for every square foot of an operation, and behind these solutions is a carefully selected team that shares our vision, culture, and core values.

We are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where every team member can thrive. When you join us, you become part of a family that values your growth, well-being, and contributions. Together, we innovate, solve challenges, and celebrate successes.

 
 

**Additional Benefits**

* Competitive Salary and Bonus Structure
* Generous Paid Time Off
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* Company HSA Contribution

card.title: Plywood Plant Manager
card.description:
**Scope:**

This position has responsibility to supervise, directly and through subordinate supervisors, all aspects of the activities involved in plywood manufacturing including responsibility for safety, planning, scheduling, and production; to inspect and ship the mill's products; to elicit service and maintenance of physical structures and equipment; to control in-process and finished inventories; quality and costs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for implementing the Company’s policies, procedures, and management actions to ensure compliance with Sustainable Forestry Management, third party certification programs (SFI, FSC, & PEFC), and Chain-of-Custody system certification requirements.
* Responsible for communicating the Company’s SFI commitment and promotion of sustainable forestry practices to employees, wood producers, and suppliers.
* Responsible for staffing efficiently and adequately for all required activities to manage and maintain labor and resources that promote efficient, safe operations with a high level of productivity.
* Plan, develop, and maintain necessary budgets and operating plans.
* Assure development and use of adequate controls and reporting systems to monitor and report safety, budget, quality, production, and maintenance information to leadership.
* May assist in strategic planning to include plant/department budgets, capital projects, veneer and lumber processing, inventory levels, operating strategies, new product lines, training, staffing, and environmental compliance.
* May be responsible for coordinating, planning, and scheduling production to optimize equipment utilization, changes to economic and sales conditions, and to meet customer demands.
* Ensure the establishment and maintenance of safe and healthy working conditions and areas for all employees.
* Lead Boise Improvement Cycle (BIC) activities within area of responsibility.
* Identify or develop and deploy best practices throughout entire manufacturing facility in area of responsibility.
* Maintain company policy and regulatory compliance in supervising/managing.
* Develop good employee relations, promptly handle and resolve employee complaints and grievances, and proactively communicate with employees.
* Communicate operational goals and strategic initiatives for area of responsibility.
* Train and develop workforce to meet job requirements.
* Demonstrate strong commitment to safety, quality, environmental awareness, and continuous process improvement.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Compensation:**

$136,000 - $204,000

**Qualifications:**

College degree, or equivalent work experience in related job function. Minimum of eight (8) to ten (10) years of experience in manufacturing/wood products/management, including demonstrated responsibility for all areas identified. Requires a self-motivated, results-oriented individual with good analytical and communication skills, excellent planning and organizational skills, and a demonstrated commitment to the process of continuous improvement. A solid understanding of manufacturing practices and equipment is required. Must have the ability to work well with people at all levels and facilitate change and growth as needed in a team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor of Science, or technical degree in related field (Engineering, Forestry, Wood Science). Prefer more than ten (10) years of experience in manufacturing/wood products/management, including demonstrated responsibility for all areas identified.
